title: NEBench R1: a Reasoning Benchmark for Evaluating Nuclear Domain Competence in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.21682v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored for knowledge-intensive and safety-critical applications in nuclear engineering. However, existing nuclear-domain benchmarks provide limited content coverage or focus primarily on answer accuracy without systematically evaluating the quality of the underlying reasoning. This study introduces NEBench R1, a reasoning-oriented benchmark comprising 7,546 unique multiple-choice questions extracted from U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) reactor operator licensing examinations covering 18 nuclear facilities. Each question is classified according to the NRC Knowledge and Abilities catalogs and accompanied by an official explanation serving as a reference for reasoning evaluation. Six LLMs were evaluated, with overall accuracy ranging from 34.0% to 73.9% across three distinct performance tiers. To assess reasoning quality, an LLM-based judge evaluated correctly answered responses

translated_title: NEBench R1：用于评估大语言模型核领域能力的推理基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正被越来越多地探索应用于核工程中的知识密集型和安全关键型任务。然而，现有的核领域基准测试要么内容覆盖有限，要么主要关注答案准确性，未能系统性地评估其底层推理的质量。本研究推出了NEBench R1，这是一个面向推理的基准测试，包含7,546道独特的多项选择题，题目提取自美国核管理委员会（NRC）反应堆操作员执照考试，覆盖18个核设施。每道题目均根据NRC知识与能力（Knowledge and Abilities）目录进行分类，并附有官方解释作为推理评估的参考依据。研究共评估了六个大语言模型，其总体准确率介于34.0%至73.9%之间，呈现出三个不同的性能层级。为评估推理质量，研究采用基于大语言模型的评判器对回答正确的响应进行了评估。
tldr: 该研究提出了NEBench R1，一个包含7,546道源自美国核管理委员会反应堆操作员执照考试题目的推理导向基准测试，首次系统评估了大语言模型在核领域的知识能力与推理质量，发现六个模型的准确率仅介于34.0%至73.9%之间。
en_tdlr: This study introduces NEBench R1, a reasoning-oriented benchmark of 7,546 multiple-choice questions derived from NRC reactor operator licensing exams, which for the first time systematically evaluates both knowledge competence and reasoning quality of large language models in the nuclear domain, revealing accuracies ranging from 34.0% to 73.9% across six models.
